svg.title: Observed Alert Triage failure modes
svg.desc: Three observed, reproducible failure modes from committed evaluation runs.
svg.text: OBSERVED IN THE LAB · NOT HYPOTHETICAL

text.tspan: The scanner deception — trusting the alert text over the…
the alert is 2,100 failed logins against a host — it reads as brute force, and the query_events telemetry explicitly notes
the source is the authorized Nessus scanner pool (change CHG-88213). Runbook RB-FP-02 says that's a false positive. Both…
Ignored compound clause — under-escalating active threats on…
RB-ESC-01 requires escalation to incident response when an active threat touches a crown-jewel asset or an admin identity.
Mistral routes these to the ordinary analyst queue — it retrieves the asset record showing privilege: admin, retrieves the…
Over-escalation — the opposite error, on a different model
kimi escalates standard-asset, standard-privilege active threats to incident response when the runbook says route to an
analyst. Where Mistral under-escalates, kimi over-escalates.

svg.text: Open FAILURE_MODES.md for scenario IDs, evidence, impact, and reproduction commands.
